info.name: npm Hooks Downloads Trusted Publishers API
List trusted publishers for a package

params.name: package
params.description: The name of the package, URL-encoded for scoped packages (e.g., @scope%2Fpackage).

items.docs: Retrieves the trusted publisher configurations for a given package. Each configuration specifies a CI/CD provider and the conditions under which it is trusted to publish.

info.name: Add a trusted publisher for a package

params.name: package
params.description: The name of the package, URL-encoded for scoped packages (e.g., @scope%2Fpackage).

items.docs: Configures a new trusted publisher for a package. This allows the specified CI/CD provider to publish the package using OIDC token exchange without requiring long-lived npm tokens. Only users with write permissions on the package can configure trusted publishers.

info.name: Remove a trusted publisher from a package

params.name: package
params.description: The name of the package, URL-encoded for scoped packages (e.g., @scope%2Fpackage).

params.name: publisher_id
params.description: The identifier of the trusted publisher configuration to remove.

items.docs: Removes a trusted publisher configuration from a package, revoking the CI/CD provider's ability to publish via OIDC token exchange.
